This is meaningful instructional reinforcement rather than generic repetition, so no_relation is too strong. It does not, however, show substantive extension or dependency: the two bullets are taught concurrently in the same term, the spelling routine is a broad weekly practice (phonics lessons and sight words generally, not split digraphs specifically), and nothing in the bounded evidence shows either statement deepening or extending the other. A same-term buildsTowards in either direction is therefore unsupported; the symmetric relatesTo with null direction is the correct complete judgment. Evidence is bounded (24 omitted source-evidence items per endpoint) and ancestors carry merge/audit context, which tempers confidence without blocking judgment.

The nomination signals are weak (shared Grade ancestor, rank gap 0, one shared LC tag 'oral', shared token 'a'), so the judgment rests on the substantive oral-language coherence, not shared wording or hierarchy.
